en: An illustrated postcard depicting a large, elegant building complex with gardens in front, surrounded by fences and greenery. The architecture features a central tower and multiple wings. The background shows hills, with a solitary structure on the hilltop. There is German text at the top and at the bottom, with 'GRAZ.' prominently printed in large letters. The building is labeled 'Kloster - Schule der ehrw. Ursulinen,' indicating it is a convent school of the Ursuline order.
